ZAF.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs says its new Electronic Travel Authorisation, using machine learning to automate visa processes, will begin user acceptance testing at the end of September 2025, with a first phase for G20 delegates opening in mid-October.

ZAF.note: The ETA is a visa tool for general administration, not a named sector system in service.
No locally built AI model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
The document concerns a travel authorisation, not a national identity system.
